title: 1 chamada perdida: SHINY
concept: A missed-call notification from 'SHINY' opens a loss-framed hypothetical (without an alarm the shiny despawns while a red timer drains: '…tarde demais.'), then the world turns KizuBot violet and a real customer alarm shows the shiny detected and caught at the same minute, 16:42 — 'Nem precisou atender.'
claims: detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

tiktok.caption: 1 chamada perdida: SHINY 😭 Sem alarme, você descobre tarde demais. Com KizuBot o zap avisa na hora — print real: detectou e capturou às 16:42. Já perdeu algum shiny assim? Link na bio.

youtube.title: 1 chamada perdida: SHINY (com KizuBot nem precisa atender)
youtube.description: Sem alarme, o shiny some antes de você ver. Com o KizuBot, o alarme chega no WhatsApp na hora: shiny detectado às 16:42 e capturado às 16:42 (print real de cliente). kizubot.com

instagram.caption: 1 chamada perdida: SHINY 😭 Com KizuBot o alarme chega no WhatsApp na hora — e ele ainda captura. Já perdeu algum shiny assim? Link na bio.

notes: Hook ordered like a real notification ('SHINY' as the caller, then '1 chamada perdida.') instead of '1 CHAMADA PERDIDA: SHINY.'. The despawn scene is an abstract illustration (generic gold star on a tile with a draining timer), clearly hypothetical. Turn line changed from 'Com KizuBot, ele te chama na hora:' to 'Com KizuBot, o zap avisa na hora:' because alarms arrive on WhatsApp/Telegram, not as calls. The two alarm bubbles are the same print (shiny-cubone--alarm) split at the gap between bubbles; redaction pills untouched; labels 'SHINY DETECTADO'/'CAPTURADO' translate the bubble text and both 16:42 stamps are highlighted. Added the payoff 'Nem precisou atender.' + chip 'alarme no WhatsApp'. Rubric: hook 9, re-hooks 9, clarity 9, craft 8, truth 9, sound 9, brand 8, CTA 9, loop 8, distinct 9 = 8.7.
